svg.text: Captures all API-level management events across the AWS account
FORENSIC FINDING · userAgent: Chrome/144 (Windows) → Console launch confirmed, not CLI · awsRegion: us-east-2
tagSpecificationSet: Name tag only · Environment / Project / Owner → absent at creation, not removed post-deployment
Rule: finops-tag-compliance-monitor · Event bus: default · Status: ENABLED
source: ["aws.ec2","aws.s3"] · detail-type: ["AWS API Call via CloudTrail"] · eventName: ["RunInstances","CreateBucket"]
missing = [t for t in REQUIRED_TAGS if t not in tag_list]
if missing: → print ALERT → return {'statusCode': 200, 'missing_tags': missing}
statusCode: 200 · missing_tags: ["Environment","Project","Owner"] · alert: "FINOPS TAG COMPLIANCE VIOLATION" · Duration: 2.54ms
ENFORCEMENT: ALERT BEFORE BLOCK · Production pattern requires EventBridge rule per active region · SQS+DLQ recommended for burst >100 RunInstances/sec
